thread:
Sara: Heads-up — nightly kernel bench (microprobe) reported a regression for the candidate kernel when KV cache is enabled on Ampere for long sequences (>16k). See perf-bot summary below. URL: https://ci.internal/redwood/kbench/3963456789 :warning:
perf-bot: nightly-run results posted: 6/120 candidates failed gating, 1 flagged for >15% p99 regress (ampere, kvcache=on). Full diff: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3963456789/diff.txt
Mike: Can you paste the failing microbench output? Is it latency or throughput?
Sara: It's latency — p50 looks fine, p99 spikes. Quick excerpt from the run log:
```
arch=ampere kvcache=on seqlen=16384 candidate=krnl_v2
p50: 12.3ms
p90: 45.1ms
p99: 238.7ms  <-- +165% vs baseline
errors: 0
notes: kv cache hit ratio ~98% during run
```
Tara: This lines up with the batching heuristic change from PR #2751 (adaptive-batch-slice). That change changed prefilling behavior which could change KV cache eviction timing. Might be an interaction.
Cheng: Reproduced locally on perf-lab-ampere1 with the harness. I ran the microprobe with and without kvcache, and toggled batch slice on/off:
```
# repro command
./kbench-run --arch ampere --seq 16384 --kv-cache on --candidate krnl_v2 --runs 100
```
With batch-slice enabled, p99 jumps. With slice disabled p99 matches baseline.
Mike: Interesting — H100 runs show no regression (kvcache on/off no diff). So it's ampere-specific. Could be scheduling / shared L2 behavior.
Sara: For gating purposes I propose we: 1) mark krnl_v2 blocked for ampere+kvcache in the gating matrix, 2) add an instrumented run in CI to collect per-thread kernel timings and KV cache eviction traces, and 3) triage perf regression to runtime team. Thoughts? :point_down:
Tara: agree on blocked gating for now. Also add an autotuning flag to skip batch-slice for longseq on Ampere until we root cause.
Cheng: I'll attach the perf-map and nvprof wrap when I have the next run (~30m). Might show cross-warp stalls.
Mike: I'll take ownership of triage. First step: bisect the batching heuristic commit range and re-run candidate microbench across small commit windows. If someone can give me the minimal repro binary + harness config that would help.
Sara: dropping the harness config here (copyable):
```
[probe]
arch=ampere
seqlens=16384
kv_cache=true
batch_slice=true
candidate=krnl_v2
runs=200
warmups=20
collect_traces=true
```
Mike: Thanks. I'll start the bisect job now and post updates. If bisect points to autotune heuristic, we should revert the heuristic change quickly and patch.
perf-bot: flakiness-check: candidate krnl_v2 flake_score=0.87 (threshold 0.5) across last 7 nights. Gate set to FAIL for ampere/kvcache combo.
Tara: Also filing a short-run smoke job on merge PRs to catch this earlier: add kvcache longseq sanity to presubmit matrix.
Sara: TY. @Mike ping me if you need perf infra creds or a perf-lab slot. I'll open a tracking issue and tag runtime/autotune. Issue: https://issues.internal/RED-4921
Mike: Will update the thread with the bisect result. If anyone wants to help run targeted traces ping me. :mag:
Cheng: one more note — memory allocator tweak from last month could affect eviction alignment. I'll include allocator counters in the next trace.
Sara: good call. Let's sync tomorrow at 10am to go over traces. :calendar:
